chapters.title: Two Suitcases Do Not Make One Household
chapters.specific_review: Thursday second course week follows185; Friday visits keep aunt out of town and Julian parents across the same city. Station confusion corrected before travel; work and chilled-food care retained.

chapters.title: A Territorial Dispute in the Fridge
chapters.specific_review: Saturday dinner and refrigerator conflict follow arrivals. Julian returns for one night only and sleeps at his own flat; consensual soup sharing avoids family rivalry reset.

chapters.title: You Do Not Have to Be There for Everything
chapters.specific_review: Sunday mother meets her own friend; aunt needs only a readable lamp-shop address. Breakfast plan settled that morning, no unsupported prior disclosure. Julian returns to training that afternoon.

chapters.title: Whose Signature Dish?
chapters.specific_review: Sunday remote cooking occurs after Julian returns to course accommodation. Cooking safety uses thermometer and prompt refrigeration, not camera omniscience; family anecdotes are mutual rather than girlfriend assessment.

chapters.title: Spare Sheets Stay This Time
chapters.specific_review: Monday departures and final course week remain explicit. Revised sheets location is consistent. Housing discussion defers decisions, preserves separate homes and relative invitation authority.

chapters.title: Between Staying Over and Moving In
chapters.specific_review: Course ends before return. Overnight invitation does not equal moving in. Cat sock behavior is ordinary, not a housing verdict. Next-day questions preserve both tenancies.

chapters.title: Whose Bookshelf Cannot Move?
chapters.specific_review: Actual routes, noise, workroom and carrier clearance drive housing comparisons. Written approval for both adults and cat is required; no lease signed yet.

chapters.title: How Much Each Pays Is Not an Exam
chapters.specific_review: Sustainable take-home income differs from business turnover. Unequal shares preserve agency, reserves and separate accounts. One-week permitted guest trial precedes any tenancy notice.

chapters.title: The Third Day of a Trial Stay
chapters.specific_review: Third-day noise/light/dishes conflict produces physical tests and changed behavior. Cat water/litter access retained. Next morning improves without an effortless-cure claim.

chapters.title: Moving In Does Not Mean Swallowing You Whole
chapters.specific_review: Several weeks and completed trial precede approved joint tenancy and move. Independent space, desk/bookcase, blue cup and familiar cat box pay off earlier scenes. Revised cat behavior is observed, never directly received as thoughts; no premature marriage or children.
